messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to create release/1.14 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Who's available to run the branch-create job and who should we whitelist for cherry-picks into release/*?

maria: I can run the job if @alex is busy. Do we still want the 'no new features' gate for this cut? :thinking_face:

tj: Yes, no new features after cut. Only bugfix + security + changelog bumps. Please add PRs to the backport queue.

jen: Quick question: do we allow docs-only PRs straight to release/* or should they go to main and be backported?

alex: Docs-only should go to main and we backport if it affects installer/upgrade docs. Keep release/* minimal.

carol: For permissions — can we keep the existing list: eng-leads + release-approvers group? If so I can update the ACLs before the cut.

alex: Yes please. Update release-approvers to include @maria @tj @jen and @carol. Owners should avoid force-pushes.

release-bot: [automated] branch-create scheduled: release/1.14 at 1993460400 (09:00 PT).

maria: I'll plan to run the job at 08:55 PT to smoke test branch creation and CI.

alex: Can people who intend to request cherry-picks post their PR numbers here by EOD? Makes backport triage easier.

jen: Adding mine: #9212 (changelog bump), #9224 (fix flaky e2e).

carol: I have two backport candidates: #9180 (hotfix for model loading) and #9187 (metrics tag fix). Will open the cherry-pick PRs against release/1.14 post-cut.

maria: Reminder for version bump: please include the CHANGELOG entry with the conventional header '### Bug fixes' or '### Security' so the release notes script picks it up.

alex: Good call. Also, per policy: cherry-picks must include an issue/PR link, a short test plan, and the approver from release-approvers. If any cherrypick touches runtime/serving, ping @tj for extra review.

carol: Noted. One more: do we allow backports from forks or only from branches in repo? We had one broken CI because of fork token limits last time.

tj: Prefer branches in repo for backports. Forks are OK but team must triage CI flakes. If you must use a fork, mark it with 'CI:manual' and a reviewer will run manual checks.

jen: Will the cut window include a short freeze for docs merges? I can hold any docs merges 30m around the cut to avoid merge conflicts.

alex: Yes please. Docs freeze from 08:45-09:15 PT.

maria: Anyone want me to run the post-cut smoke checklist? I can run: checkout branch, run unit tests, run small integration smoke, confirm changelog generation.

alex: That'd be awesome. Please paste the smoke checklist output here after.

release-bot: [info] After branch creation, the CI will run pipeline: build -> unit tests -> e2e-smoke. Allow up to 20 min for initial CI.

tj: I'll monitor runtime-related flakes and look at any failures immediately.

alex: OK — TL;DR: branch-create 09:00 PT, release-approvers updated, docs freeze 08:45-09:15, backport policy reminder (bug/security/changelog only). Post PR numbers in this thread by EOD. Thanks! :thumbsup:
